label: Conspiracy that was TRUE

szenen.text: In 1962, America's top generals signed a plan to *attack their own country.*
The idea: stage *fake terror attacks* and blame Cuba.
Fake hijackings. A *staged ship explosion.* Even attacks in Miami.
All to give America an excuse to go to *war.*
The plan reached the desk of the defense secretary.
We only know because the files were *declassified in 1997.*
What else is still classified? Follow for more.

caption:
Operation Northwoods (1962): the Joint Chiefs of Staff proposed staged attacks to justify war with Cuba. Rejected – and declassified in 1997. 🗂️ Did you know about this? 👇
